tasks.title: Fix 3 Cross-Location City Name Bleeds in Franchise Meta Descriptions
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: <head> -> <meta name="description"> & <meta property="og:description"> (Rank Math Meta Box). Copy-paste territory bleed across 3 franchise 'Assisted Living Placement Guidance' pages: (1) North Orlando (/northorlando/) outputs 'Memphis / Greater Memphis'; (2) Memphis (/memphis/) outputs 'Wilmington and West Chester / Delaware and Pennsylvania'; (3) Wilmington & West Chester (/wilmingtonwestchester/) outputs 'Frederick & Loudoun / Maryland and Virginia'.
tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates severe geographic keyword cannibalization and prevents families searching in Orlando, Memphis, or Wilmington from seeing a completely different state/city in Google SERP snippets.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
WHERE IN CMS: WordPress Multisite Admin -> Subsite Pages -> Edit 'Assisted Living Placement Guidance' -> Rank Math SEO Snippet Editor -> Description field:

1. North Orlando (/northorlando/senior-living-guidance/assisted-living-placement-guidance/):
   Replace 'Memphis' / 'Greater Memphis' with:
   "Find trusted assisted living placement guidance in North Orlando and Central Florida. Owl Be There helps families compare communities and make confident choices."

2. Memphis (/memphis/senior-living-guidance/assisted-living-placement-guidance/):
   Replace 'Wilmington and West Chester' / 'Delaware and Pennsylvania' with:
   "Trusted assisted living placement guidance in Greater Memphis, TN. Owl Be There helps local families compare senior care options at no cost to you."

3. Wilmington & West Chester (/wilmingtonwestchester/senior-living-guidance/assisted-living-placement-guidance/):
   Replace 'Frederick & Loudoun' / 'Maryland and Virginia' with:
   "Personalized assisted living placement guidance in Wilmington, DE and West Chester, PA. Compare vetted local senior living communities with Owl Be There."
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the 3 franchise URLs displays its own verified city and state in <meta name="description"> and <meta property="og:description">.
All 3 descriptions remain under 155 characters / 920 pixels.

tasks.title: Editorial Strategy Review: Truncated Titles (>60c, 7 Pages) & Meta Descriptions (>155c, 19 Pages)
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: <head> -> <title> & <meta name="description">. Screaming Frog crawler advisory audit flags: (1) 7 franchise landing pages where <title> tags measure 61-68 characters (e.g., /wilmingtonwestchester/contact-us/ at 68 chars: 'Contact Owl Be There Wilmington–West Chester | Senior Living Advisor'); (2) 19 pages where meta descriptions measure 156-163 characters (just 1 to 8 characters past the ideal 155c cutoff, with /wilmingtonwestchester/about-us/ at 203 chars). NOTE: These pages are NOT technically broken; they represent minor SERP snippet truncation. Changing them requires content and branding alignment so as not to dilute local keyword intent or brand tone.
tasks.businessImpact: Optimizes Google SERP snippet display without ellipses (...) on local search results, improving organic click-through rate while protecting branding copy.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. Content Specialists (Dana / Octav) review the 7 titles and 19 descriptions documented in Tab 2 of the Master Technical SEO Workbook.
2. Tighten titles to <= 60 characters while preserving the local city and primary service keyword.
3. Trim meta descriptions to 140-155 characters (e.g. trimming trailing boilerplate) so Google displays full sentences in search snippets.
4. Apply changes via WordPress Rank Math snippet editor during regular copy review.
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewed titles measure <= 60 characters and <= 580 pixels.
Reviewed descriptions measure 140-155 characters without losing geographic keyword targeting.
tasks.verificationMethod: Cross-reference updated titles/descriptions against Master Workbook Tab 2.

• Kelly_and_David_Circular_Transparent-1-1-2.png (1.43 MB) — on https://owlbethere.com/about-us/ inside Leadership Team Grid under 'Meet Our Founders'.
• group.png (1.19 MB) — on franchise guidance pages like https://owlbethere.com/greaterwashingtondc/senior-living-guidance/.
• hero-photo-assisted-living.png (1.07 MB) — on franchise assisted living pages like https://owlbethere.com/wilmingtonwestchester/senior-living-guidance/assisted-living-placement-guidance/ (Above-the-Fold Hero LCP element).
• section-photo-living-guidance-hub-933x1024.png (901 KB) — on franchise pages like https://owlbethere.com/charleston/senior-living-guidance/.
2. ROOT CAUSE: Original high-res PNGs were uploaded into subsite `/wp-content/uploads/sites/[id]/2026/` media folders without WebP compression.
tasks.businessImpact: Reduces hero and section image payload by >85% (from ~1.1 MB to <120 KB per page), directly improving mobile Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) across all 7 franchise markets.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
3. READY-TO-TEST CODE / CLI BATCH:
```bash
# Live example verified: /wp-content/uploads/sites/5/2026/07/hero-photo-assisted-living.png
for f in $(find wp-content/uploads -name "hero-photo-assisted-living.png" -o -name "group.png" -o -name "section-photo-living-guidance-hub-933x1024.png" -o -name "Kelly_and_David_Circular_Transparent-1-1-2*.png"); do
  cwebp -q 82 "$f" -o "${f%.png}.webp"
done
```
